name: Strawberry, Spinach & Quinoa Salad with Balsamic Vinaigrette

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: In a small saucepan, combine quinoa and broth. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups quinoa
708 ml (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry spinach and basil. Thinly slice the leaves into ribbons and transfer to a large bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (142 g) pkg baby spinach
1 ½ small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Wash, trim and discard stem ends, and slice strawberries. Add to bowl with spinach and basil.
In a small bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together oil, vinegar, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
9 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp balsamic vinegar
¾ tsp Dijon mustard
¾ tsp honey
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add almonds and, stirring constantly, cook until golden brown, 1-2 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ cup almonds, sliced

instructions.primary_message: Uncover quinoa and fluff with a fork. Drain any excess liquid and add to bowl with other ingredients. Toss salad.
To serve, arrange salad on a plate, crumble goat cheese over top, sprinkle with almonds, and drizzle with dressing. Enjoy!
